evidence.quote: "I'll change you back into yourself."
"The monster kidnapped a princess 13 years ago on Earth. Thirteen years on Earth is equal to 13 days in Heaven."
The Tang Monk was back!

answers.rationale: 悟空明确说会把师父变回原身，随后唐僧恢复；天上一日对应地上约一年，并非时间相同，公主也是被妖怪绑走而非从天庭逃走，所以只有 A 为真。

evidence.quote: "That monster said he remembered me," thought Wukong.
"He must be from Heaven. I'll go up there now to see if any spirits are missing."

answers.rationale: 悟空因妖怪说“记得我”而推断它来自天庭；妖怪没有自称来自天庭，原文也未把其力量作为推断依据。

evidence.quote: The monster turned into a wolf and flew up to the god.
He turned and led the wolf back up to Heaven.

answers.rationale: 木狼星变回狼后被神带回天庭；宝象国是悟空随后独自返回的地点，花果山没有参与这一去向。

evidence.quote: "I never should have told you to leave. Will you continue the journey with us?"
Wukong smiled. "We will reach the Western Paradise together."

answers.rationale: 唐僧请求悟空继续同行，悟空答应一起到西天；他没有要求悟空回山或再去寻找已经被带走的狼精。

evidence.quote: The monkey turned himself into a woodpecker and pecked the log.
"That was me, Bajie!" shouted Wukong.
"My name is Golden Horn," said the demon.

answers.rationale: 变成啄木鸟的是悟空而非悟净；悟空确实知道八戒睡觉，八戒也确实遇到金角，因此 A 是唯一不真实项。

evidence.quote: "Bajie, go up the road and search the mountain. There might be a demon up there, and I don't want Master to get hurt."

answers.rationale: 悟空明确让八戒上路搜山；河流和田野都不是指定搜索地点。

evidence.quote: "I'm going to follow the pig. I want to make sure he really searches the mountain."
The monkey turned invisible and followed Bajie up the road.

answers.rationale: 悟空决定隐身跟踪八戒以确认他认真搜山；打盹是八戒的决定，悟空也不是自己另行搜妖。

evidence.quote: The monkey turned himself into a woodpecker and pecked the log.
Tap, tap, tap! Tap, tap, tap! Bajie rolled over and mumbled.

answers.rationale: 悟空变成啄木鸟啄木头发出敲击声；狐狸出现在八戒后来搜山时，妖怪也不是午睡时的敲击者。

evidence.quote: The pig soon came to a cave.
In front of the cave was a demon.

answers.rationale: 八戒在山路尽头的洞前看到妖怪；木头是他先前睡觉处，树前没有出现该妖怪。

evidence.quote: "A tiger attacked me," said the old monk.
"He isn't really a monk," he thought.
Wukong walked over and picked up the old monk.

answers.rationale: 悟空看出老人并非真和尚并认定他要害师父；老人口中的老虎伤的是老人自己的腿，背老人的是悟空而非悟净，所以只有 A 为真。

evidence.quote: A third mountain appeared on top of the first two.
Wukong's knees buckled, and all three mountains crashed down on top of him.

answers.rationale: 第三座山落到前两座之上，原文明确称三座山压住悟空；不是四座或五座。

evidence.quote: "Take this magic gourd to the monkey. Say his name, and he will be sucked into the gourd. After an hour he will turn into liquid."
He was about to push again when the mountains rose into the air.
He flew fast up to Heaven.

answers.rationale: 悟空离体飞到天庭，故 A 为真；变成液体只是葫芦对被吸入者的威胁，托起群山的是山神而非悟空。

evidence.quote: A spirit stood nearby.
The spirit bowed and then vanished with the mountains.

answers.rationale: 山神现身并带着群山消失，从而释放悟空；妖怪和天门守卫都没有救他。

evidence.quote: He handed a gourd to one of the demons.
"Take this magic gourd to the monkey. Say his name, and he will be sucked into the gourd. After an hour he will turn into liquid."

answers.rationale: 金角把魔法葫芦交给小妖去收悟空；猴子和天门都不是交付物。

evidence.quote: "I'll ask the guard to close the gate and dim the stars. Then it will look like Heaven's gone."
"When I say 'Heaven,' close the gate and dim the stars."

answers.rationale: 悟空计划并请求守卫关天门、让星星变暗；“喊悟空名字”是妖怪使用葫芦的方法，不是悟空对守卫的请求，所以 A 是未请求项。

evidence.quote: "I was tricked!" cried the demon.
"I must tell Golden Horn."

answers.rationale: 小妖发现受骗后说必须告诉金角；玉帝和唐僧都不是他要警告的人。

evidence.quote: The monkey tried to get out of the way, but the rope snagged him.
The more Wukong tried to wriggle free, the tighter the rope got.

answers.rationale: 金绳套住悟空后，他越挣扎绳子越紧；绳子没有变松或断裂。

evidence.quote: "Sun Wukong is my twin brother. My name is Sun Kongwu."
"How will I get out of here? I know I won't turn into liquid because I'm going to live forever. But I still have to save my friends."
Wukong slipped the gourd into his robe.

answers.rationale: 结尾悟空偷走并藏起真正的葫芦，故 A 为真；“孪生兄弟”是他的谎话，他也明确知道自己不会在葫芦里化死。

evidence.quote: He plucked a hair and made it look almost exactly like himself.
He quickly made a fake gourd with one of his hairs.

answers.rationale: 悟空明确造了假悟空和假葫芦；午饭是金角正在吃的真实食物，不是悟空制造的，因此 A 是未制造项。

evidence.quote: He plucked a hair and made it look almost exactly like himself.
The fake Wukong had no legs.

answers.rationale: 原文直接说明假悟空唯一的差别是没有腿；并非缺手或缺眼。

evidence.quote: The gourd shot out light as Golden Horn removed the cap.
The tiny Wukong leaped out, unseen.

answers.rationale: 金角为查看情况取下葫芦盖，微小的悟空趁机跳出；悟空没有砸碎葫芦，也不是自己从内部开盖。

evidence.quote: Wukong picked up the gourd.
Wukong slipped the gourd into his robe.

answers.rationale: 悟空拿起并把真葫芦藏进袍中；他没有偷金角的午饭或金绳。

evidence.quote: Then Laozi the sage stood before the travelers.
"Golden Horn works for me," said Laozi.
"The gourd won't harm him. Good-bye."

answers.rationale: 来访老人显出老子真身，老子也说明葫芦不会伤金角；本集没有佛祖亲自拜访旅行者，所以 A 是唯一不真实项。

evidence.quote: "Let me try mine," said Wukong. "Golden Horn!"
Shloomp! Instantly the demon was sucked into the gourd.

answers.rationale: 悟空喊出金角名字后，金角立刻被吸进葫芦；他没有逃出山洞或去寺院。

evidence.quote: "Golden Horn works for me," said Laozi.
"I sent him here to cause trouble for you. Buddha wanted to make sure you are all serious about reaching the Western Paradise. You fought well, Wukong."

answers.rationale: 老子明确说派金角来给取经队制造麻烦；不是让他与悟空同行或守护唐僧。

evidence.quote: "Give me my gourd, Wukong!" boomed the sage.
Wukong took the gourd out of his robe and handed it to the sage.

answers.rationale: 老子要求归还并接过“我的葫芦”，表明真正主人是老子；悟空和金角都只是暂时持有。

evidence.quote: The Tang Monk was almost asleep when he heard a moaning sound from outside.
A man stood in the doorway, dripping wet.

answers.rationale: 夜里进入唐僧房间的是一个浑身滴水的男人；老子已离开，来者也不是老妇人。

evidence.quote: "My kingdom suffered a horrible drought five years ago. Crops wouldn't grow, and my people were starving. One day a Daoist arrived in the kingdom. He said he had great powers and could pray for rain."

"After the Daoist brought the rain, we became close friends. One day we were walking when I noticed a strange light coming from my well. I went to the well and looked in. Suddenly I felt someone push me in. It was the Daoist! He had made the light with magic so he could trick me. I fell deep into the water, and he sealed the well shut."
"My body is still down there. I'm just a . . . ghost."

answers.rationale: 被道士推入井中的是国王本人，且他以鬼魂来见唐僧；乌鸡国也确实遭过旱灾，所以“王子困在井中”是唯一不真实项。

evidence.quote: The king held up a jade coin.
"This is the one royal treasure I still have. When my son sees it, he'll know you're telling the truth."

answers.rationale: 国王留下能证明身份的玉钱给唐僧；箭属于王子次日狩猎，公鸡并非信物。

evidence.quote: He told the prince everything.
Wukong pushed Bajie, and the pig splashed into the water.

answers.rationale: 唐僧确实把道士真相告诉王子，悟空也确实把八戒推进井中；八戒后来只谎称悟空能复活国王来报复，并不知道处置假王的方法，所以 A 是不真实项。

evidence.quote: The Tang Monk reached into his robe.
"That coin belongs to my father! It's a royal treasure."

answers.rationale: 唐僧向王子出示玉钱，王子认出它是父王宝物；他没有展示井或王冠。

evidence.quote: In a small courtyard, Wukong rushed toward a well.
"The treasure is in this well," said the monkey, pulling the lid off.

answers.rationale: 悟空明确声称宝藏在井里；宫殿和天庭都不是他诱骗八戒所说的地点。

evidence.quote: The body of a man lay on a table.
"This is the Black Rooster King's body," said the dragon.

answers.rationale: 井龙王保管的尸体被明确认作乌鸡国王；不是邪道士或王子的身体。

evidence.quote: The next morning the Tang Monk looked at the king's body.
"Wukong can bring him back to life," said Bajie suddenly.

answers.rationale: 八戒当着唐僧说悟空能让乌鸡国王复活；他说的不是让王子相信唐僧，也不是寻找井中宝物。
